interface.longDescription: A portable Godot and game-development toolkit for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and VS Code. It covers architecture, gameplay systems, animation, physics, UI, shaders, networking, optimization, testing, export workflows, genre patterns, publishing workflows, specialized addons, and studio-style orchestration roles. Assembled and curated by Powehi from Divergent AI / GD Agentic Skills, awesome-gamedev-agent-skills, GodotPrompter, Claude-Code-Game-Studios, godot-worldmap-builder, and other open gamedev resources.
